svg.title: Compare Annual License Receipts by Rights Package
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-license-structure-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Annual License Receipts by Rights Package; subtitle: Five illustrative agreement-level yields, all expressed in USD.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Bars show hypothetical annual operator fees for one agreement, not market royalty benchmarks, profit, or additive portfolio revenue. Assume a full licensed year, earned fees, and collection without withholding or payment charges. Minimum guarantees are creditable against royalties rather than added to them.; caption: Compare license economics on one annual fee basis; the licensee's sales remain a royalty calculation input only.; stages: label: Patent field-of-use license; value: $20,000 annual royalty from defined product sales; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: Illustrative 2% royalty on $1,000,000 of contract-defined net product sales; recognize $20,000, not the sales base. Collect against quarterly statements.; label: Brand category license; value: $30,000 annual minimum exceeds calculated royalties; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Illustrative greater of a $30,000 minimum or 4% of $600,000 net sales. The $24,000 royalty is covered by the minimum, not added to it.; label: Cleared catalog license; value: $15,000 annual fee for scheduled catalog assets; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Illustrative 100 cleared assets at $150 each for one annual use scope; additional media or territories require a separately priced amendment.; label: Controlled dataset license; value: $25,000 annual fee for bounded dataset access; numeric value: 25000.0; detail: Illustrative five business units at $5,000 annually with permitted-use and redistribution limits; access logs support scope reconciliation rather than ownership claims.; label: Bundled technology package; value: $50,000 annual fee across two licensed facilities; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: Illustrative two facilities at $25,000 annually for scheduled patent and know-how rights; define included support so service effort does not consume the margin.

text.title: Compare Annual License Receipts by Rights Package
text.tspan: Compare Annual License Receipts by Rights Package

circle.title: label: Patent field-of-use license; value: $20,000 annual royalty from defined product sales; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: Illustrative 2% royalty on $1,000,000 of contract-defined net product sales; recognize $20,000, not the sales base. Collect against quarterly statements.

label: Brand category license; value: $30,000 annual minimum exceeds calculated royalties; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Illustrative greater of a $30,000 minimum or 4% of $600,000 net sales. The $24,000 royalty is covered by the minimum, not added to it.

label: Cleared catalog license; value: $15,000 annual fee for scheduled catalog assets; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Illustrative 100 cleared assets at $150 each for one annual use scope; additional media or territories require a separately priced amendment.

label: Controlled dataset license; value: $25,000 annual fee for bounded dataset access; numeric value: 25000.0; detail: Illustrative five business units at $5,000 annually with permitted-use and redistribution limits; access logs support scope reconciliation rather than ownership claims.

label: Bundled technology package; value: $50,000 annual fee across two licensed facilities; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: Illustrative two facilities at $25,000 annually for scheduled patent and know-how rights; define included support so service effort does not consume the margin.

text.title: Assumptions: Bars show hypothetical annual operator fees for one agreement, not market royalty benchmarks, profit, or additive portfolio revenue. Assume a full licensed year, earned fees, and collection without withholding or payment charges. Minimum guarantees are creditable against royalties rather than added to them.
